bends.note: Ryan runs NNE from Dorchester to here, then turns ENE as 'RYAN AV. (NOT OPEN)' toward Reading Road; the angled leg's north line is off the top edge
Reading runs SSE (about 12 deg east of south) from the top edge to here, then turns nearly due south; the road is widest at the turn
east line straightens to due south here (x~3285); centreline ~3165 from here to Dorchester

notes: Earnshaw printed 'EARNSHAW' only (same street as sheet 174's top Earnshaw, recorded as Earnshaw Street); it continues west of Burnet onto 174 and ends at Ryan (T; the block east of Ryan has no opening). Burnet (printed 'BURNET AV.', 50 ft) and Ryan (printed 'RYAN AV.', 50 ft) both run NNE (about 8-10 deg east of north). Burnet/Dorchester is marked cross because the key map shows a street continuing south of Dorchester in line with Burnet (the south side is off this sheet); Ryan/Dorchester is a T. Dorchester (printed 'DORCHESTER AV.', 50 ft, south line off the paper) becomes 'FLORENCE AV.' east of Reading: recorded as both Reading/Dorchester and Reading/Florence at the same point (name change at Reading). Reading printed 'READING R'D' and 'READING', 70 ft at the top and at Dorchester; recorded as Reading Road. Reading continues south of Dorchester off the sheet. The Ryan (angled, not open)/Reading junction would lie north of the paper edge near (2830,~100) and is not recorded. No streets enter from the east side of Reading on this sheet (Boyle Engineering cover pastes, no openings). Interior lines in the Burnet-Ryan block are lot lines, not alleys. Scale: 50 ft = ~170 px.
